verses.sanskrit: ॐ भूर्भुवः स्वः | ॐ तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि | धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात् ||
verses.transliteration: oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ | oṃ tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi | dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt ||
verses.translation: We meditate on the glory of that Being who has produced this universe; may He enlighten our minds.
verses.hindi: हम उस परमेश्वर की तेजस का ध्यान करते हैं जिसने इस सृष्टि की रचना की; वह हमारी बुद्धि को प्रकाशित करे।
verses.commentary: The Gayatri Mantra, the most sacred Vedic mantra, is chanted during Sandhya Vandana. It addresses Savita (the Sun) as the source of all illumination and seeks enlightenment of the intellect.

verses.sanskrit: ॐ असतो मा सद्गमय | तमसो मा ज्योतिर्गमय | मृत्योर्मा अमृतं गमय ||
verses.transliteration: oṃ asato mā sadgamaya | tamaso mā jyotirgamaya | mṛtyormā amṛtaṃ gamaya ||
verses.translation: From untruth lead me to truth; from darkness lead me to light; from death lead me to immortality.
verses.hindi: असत्य से मुझे सत्य की ओर ले जाओ; अंधकार से मुझे ज्योति की ओर ले जाओ; मृत्यु से मुझे अमृत की ओर ले जाओ।
verses.commentary: The Shanti Mantra from the Brihadaranyaka Upanishad, recited during Sandhya to invoke peace and seek progression from ignorance to knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: गायत्री चन्द्रार्कयोस्तु त्रिकाल सन्ध्या विधिः | प्रातः मध्यान्द सायंकाले सम्यक् सन्ध्योपसेवनम् ||
verses.transliteration: gāyatrī candrārkayostu trikāla sandhyā vidhiḥ | prātaḥ madhyānda sāyaṃkāle samyak sandhyopasevanam ||
verses.translation: The Gayatri worship of the Sun and Moon is the method of three-times-daily Sandhya. Properly perform Sandhya at morning, noon, and evening.
verses.hindi: सूर्य और चंद्रमा की गायत्री पूजा तीन समय की संध्या की विधि है। प्रातःकाल, मध्याह्न और सायंकाल में उचित रूप से संध्या का अनुष्ठान करें।
verses.commentary: Sandhya Vandana is performed three times daily: at sunrise (Brahma Muhurta), noon, and sunset. These transitional times are considered spiritually potent for meditation and prayer.

verses.sanskrit: ॐ अपवित्रः पवित्रो वा सर्वावस्थां गतोऽपि वा | यः स्मरेत्पुण्डरीकाक्षं स बाह्याभ्यन्तरः शुचिः ||
verses.transliteration: oṃ apavitraḥ pavitro vā sarvāvasthāṃ gato'pi vā | yaḥ smaretpuṇḍarīkākṣaṃ sa bāhyābhyantaraḥ śuciḥ ||
verses.translation: One who is impure, or pure, or in any condition whatsoever — whoever remembers the lotus-eyed one (Vishnu) is pure both externally and internally.
verses.hindi: जो अपवित्र हो, पवित्र हो, या किसी भी अवस्था में हो — जो कमल-नयन भगवान् को स्मरण करता है, वह बाहर और भीतर दोनों से शुद्ध हो जाता है।
verses.commentary: The Pundarikaksha mantra is recited during Achamana (ritual sipping of water) at the beginning of Sandhya Vandana and other rituals. It emphasizes that remembrance of the divine purifies regardless of one's external condition.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निमीळे पुरोहितं यज्ञस्य देवमृत्विजम् | होतारं रत्नधातामम् ||
verses.transliteration: agnimīḷe purohitaṃ yajñasya devamṛtvijam | hotāraṃ ratnadhātāmam ||
verses.translation: I praise Agni, the priest, the divine minister of sacrifice, the invoker, the bestower of treasures.
verses.hindi: मैं अग्नि की स्तुति करता हूँ, जो यज्ञ का पुरोहित, देवताओं का मंत्री, आह्वानकर्ता और धन का दाता है।
verses.commentary: From Rig Veda 1.1.1, the first verse of the oldest human scripture. Agni is the messenger who carries offerings to the gods and brings their blessings back.

verses.sanskrit: स्वाहा | ॐ अग्नये स्वाहा | इदमग्नये इदं न मम ||
verses.transliteration: svāhā | oṁ agnaye svāhā | idamagnaye idam na mama ||
verses.translation: Svaha! Om, offering to Agni, Svaha. This is for Agni, this is not for me.
verses.hindi: स्वाहा! ॐ अग्नि को नमन, स्वाहा। यह अग्नि के लिए है, यह मेरे लिए नहीं।
verses.commentary: The offering mantra with 'Svaha' (offering) and the renunciation phrase 'Idam na mama' (this is not mine). This cultivates detachment while performing the ritual.

verses.sanskrit: प्रातर्दध्याद्विधिवत् शुद्धौषधिभिर्हुतम् | सायंकाले तथा कर्म सम्यगाग्निहोत्रकम् ||
verses.transliteration: prātardadhyādvidhivad śuddhauṣadhibhirhutam | sāyaṃkāle tathā karma samyagāgnihotrakam ||
verses.translation: In the morning, perform Agnihotra properly with pure substances as offerings. In the evening, perform the ritual similarly.
verses.hindi: प्रातःकाल में शुद्ध द्रव्यों से यथाविधि अग्निहोत्र करें। सायंकाल में भी इसी प्रकार कर्म करें।
verses.commentary: Agnihotra is performed twice daily—just after sunrise and just before sunset. The offerings typically include ghee, rice, and samidha (sacrificial wood).

verses.sanskrit: शुभं करोति कल्याणं आरोग्यं धनसंपदा | शत्रुभय विनाशाय दीपज्योतिर्नमोऽस्तु ते ||
verses.transliteration: śubhaṃ karoti kalyāṇaṃ ārogyaṃ dhanasaṃpadā | śatrubhaya vināśāya dīpajyotirnamo'stu te ||
verses.translation: You do good, bring auspiciousness, health, and prosperity. For the destruction of fear of enemies, I bow to the light of the lamp.
verses.hindi: तुम कल्याण करते हो, सौभाग्य, स्वास्थ्य और संपदा लाते हो। शत्रुओं के भय का नाश करने वाली दीप ज्योति को मैं प्रणाम करता हूँ।
verses.commentary: The Deepa Jyoti mantra, recited while lighting the lamp during Puja. Light symbolizes knowledge dispelling ignorance.

verses.sanskrit: गंधां धूपां दीपां नैवेद्यं च सर्वम् | पूजयामि भक्त्या देवं इष्टदेवतां नमाम्यहम् ||
verses.transliteration: gaṃdhāṃ dhūpāṃ dīpāṃ naivedyaṃ ca sarvam | pūjayāmi bhaktyā devaṃ iṣṭadevatāṃ namāmyaham ||
verses.translation: With fragrance, incense, lamp, food offerings, and all things, I worship the deity with devotion. I bow to my chosen deity.
verses.hindi: सुगंध, धूप, दीप, नैवेद्य और सभी वस्तुओं से मैं भक्ति पूर्वक देवता की पूजा करता हूँ। मैं अपनी इष्ट देवता को प्रणाम करता हूँ।
verses.commentary: The Shodashopachara (sixteen-step) Puja includes offering fragrance, incense, light, food, and other items to the deity with devotion.

verses.sanskrit: यानि कानि च पापानि जन्मान्तरकृतानि च | तानि तानि प्रणश्यन्ति प्रदक्षिणपदे पदे ||
verses.transliteration: yāni kāni ca pāpāni janmāntarakṛtāni ca | tāni tāni praṇaśyanti pradakṣiṇapade pade ||
verses.translation: Whatever sins committed in this birth and previous births, they are destroyed step by step during circumambulation.
verses.hindi: जन्म-जन्मांतर के जो भी पाप हैं, वे प्रदक्षिणा के प्रत्येक पद पर नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
verses.commentary: Recited during Pradakshina (circumambulation) around the deity or sacred space. Each step is believed to burn away karmic impurities.

verses.translation: Salutations to Lord Vasudeva (Krishna/Vishnu), the indweller of all beings.
verses.commentary: The Dwadasakshari (twelve-syllable) mantra of Vishnu. 'Vasudeva' means 'he who dwells in all beings.' Regular Japa of this mantra purifies the mind.

verses.translation: Salutations to Shiva, the auspicious one.
verses.commentary: The Panchakshari (five-syllable) mantra of Shiva. 'Shiva' means 'auspiciousness.' This mantra is among the most powerful for spiritual transformation.

verses.sanskrit: माला यस्य तु जपेन्नित्यं सा माला तस्य जीविते | यदा यदा भजते देवं तदा तदा स्मरति प्रियम् ||
verses.transliteration: mālā yasya tu japen nityaṃ sā mālā tasya jīvite | yadā yadā bhajate devaṃ tadā tadā smarati priyam ||
verses.translation: The mala with which one performs daily Japa remains with that person throughout life. Whenever one worships the deity, one remembers what is dear.
verses.hindi: जिस माला से नित्य जप किया जाता है, वह माला जीवन भर साथ रहती है। जब भी देवता की भक्ति करते हैं, प्रिय चीजें याद आती हैं।
verses.commentary: Emphasizes the importance of regular Japa practice using a mala (typically 108 beads). The mala becomes charged with the practitioner's devotion over time.

verses.translation: Salutations to the Sun, the friend of all.
verses.hindi: सभी के मित्र सूर्य को नमन।
verses.commentary: The first of twelve names of the Sun recited during Surya Namaskara. 'Mitra' means friend—the Sun is the friendly source of life for all beings.

verses.translation: Salutations to the shining one, the praise-worthy.
verses.commentary: The second name of the Sun. 'Ravi' means one who shines and is worthy of praise. The Sun's light reveals the world and dispels darkness.

verses.sanskrit: यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत | अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदात्मानं सृजाम्यहम् ||
verses.transliteration: yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānirbhavati bhārata | abhyutthānamadharmasya tadātmānaṃ sṛjāmyaham ||
verses.translation: Whenever there is a decline of dharma and rise of adharma, O Arjuna, then I manifest myself.
verses.hindi: जब भी धर्म की हानि होती है और अधर्म की वृद्धि होती है, तब मैं अपना रूप धारण करता हूँ।
verses.commentary: From the Bhagavad Gita (4.7), this verse is often recited during Surya Namaskara, honoring the Sun as an avatar of divine energy that restores dharma.
